params.caption: 🎮 Devolver Digital wants you to delete your GTA 6 pre-load With GTA 6 launching this week, Devolver Digital is riding the hype: repost its message with a video of yourself deleting your GTA 6 pre-load and you could win its upcoming game, Volvy's Adventure: Reslimed. You can always reinstall Rockstar's game afterwards, but at 212GB that will take a while. 🕒 Nov 16, 2026 · 23:27 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: GameSpot 👥 @devolverdigital · @RockstarGames 😂 Would you delete 212GB for a free game? React 👍 or 👎 and tell us below #GTA6 #DevolverDigital #VolvysAdventure #GamingNews 🔔 @LevelUpGames0
